claims.text: Today we are at Grey Point with Tobias Renn, who has kept the lighthouse there for 23 years.
An electric lamp would have cost the Trust 105 thousand dollars before a single night of light.
Because the dredging budget follows the count, and the Harbour Board sets the dredging budget every spring.

The Grey Point Trust pays for the apprentices out of visitor tickets and a small grant from the county.

quotes.text: The Grey Point Trust voted on it in March, and the old lamp won by 33 votes to nine.

quotes.speaker: Mara
quotes.text: Tobias Renn keeps a ledger of every ship that passes, and the ledger is the reason we came.
